about_the_game:
In a faraway universe, an alien civilization struggles with a critical nitrogen shortage. To save their world, a crew of four sets out to explore uncharted planets in search of vital resources. Their mission takes a tragic turn when their ship crashes on a massive Jupiter-like planet, splitting the team and casting them into a mysterious abyss.

Cut off from communication and surrounded by hostile environments, players must fight for survival. Explore vast underground landscapes, gather resources, and craft tools to overcome dangerous wildlife and natural hazards. Uncover hidden secrets of the planet, solve environmental puzzles, and progress through treacherous levels filled with unique challenges.

The game combines survival mechanics with exploration and adventure. Manage your character’s stamina and supplies, make strategic choices about where to explore, and work your way toward uncovering the truth behind the planet’s mysteries. With atmospheric environments, challenging progression, and a story-driven journey, every step brings new dangers—and new discoveries.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild fantasy violence and adventure elements. There is no blood, strong language, sexual content, or drug use. The focus is on exploration and survival in a mysterious world. Suitable for younger audiences as well as adults.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Supports 120 Hz refresh rate
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Provides 60 FPS gameplay on low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
